title: RecoveryEvent
description: One durable blocked-call recovery measurement event: a policy block, an explicit retry correlation, or a host-observed retry outcome. Produced by a deployed feedback surface and consumed by cell-registry (agindow-runtime-contract.md §10.35). Tenant identity comes from authenticated producer credentials, never from this body.

id.description: Event identity. One tenant-scoped event ID is admitted at most once; a byte-different replay is a conflict.

block_id.description: The original policy block's audit ID. The block is counted at most once.

surface.description: Deployed feedback surface identity (for example sdk-node or nango-lambda). Never a credential.

window.description: Caller-owned measurement window identity. Retry and outcome events must match the block's window.

cohort.description: Required on blocked events: the predeclared qualification cohort.

retry_id.description: Required on retry and outcome events: explicit host correlation. Never inferred from payload values.

verifier.description: Required for verified_success: the host verifier identity.

verifier_provenance.description: Required for verified_success: how the verifier established task success.

policy_violation.description: Optional independent safety assessment. Never used to count recovery.
